caption: The drawing depicts a doll with light brown skin, black painted hair, and red cheeks. The doll is wearing a long-sleeved, off-white dress with a full skirt that reaches the ankles, and there is a blue bow at the neckline. The dress has a scalloped lace hem and lace trim at the edge of the sleeves, with subtle shading to suggest folds and creases in the fabric. The doll’s feet are painted to resemble shoes with a strap detail, colored in a faint brownish tone. The arms and legs are straight and jointed at the shoulders and hips, with the hands showing simple fingers. In the lower left corner of the drawing, there is a small, sketch-like profile of the doll’s head with long black hair, drawn in pencil without color. The background is plain and uncolored, and at the bottom right corner, the name "Harry Grossen" is faintly inscribed.
title: Doll
